text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi-based Zamil Air Conditioners and General Electric Appliances begin a joint manufacturing venture that is expected to produce 30,000 air conditioning units in its first year.
- A funeral service will be held on Wednesday for an Indian family of three killed in an arson attack on Friday in Bahrain.
- Privatisation of power and water utilities in Gulf Arab states must be better planned, Bahraini expert says.
- Gulf Arab states need never stand alone against threats to the region's security, U.S. defence secretary says.
- Arab Shipbuilding and Repair Yard repairs 51 ships in the first five months of 1997. Company's operating income increases 19 percent from the same period last year to $40 million.
- An Arab economist urges Arab countries to move towards an integrated economy.
- Around 92 firms registered at Bahrain's Commerce Ministry in the first half of 1997, reflecting growth in economic activity and investment confidence.
- Bahrain Stock Exchange agrees to list Bahrain Islamic Insurance Company.
